name: Ran Bloodtooth's Skull
summary: Ran Bloodtooth's Skull is a grisly trophy taken from the chieftain of the corrupted furbolgs in Ashenvale. Brought back to the night elves of Astranaar, it serves as tangible proof that a ferocious threat to the woodland realm has been ended.

sections.title: A Trophy of Ashenvale's Defense
sections.body: The forests of Ashenvale have suffered immensely from demonic taint and wilderness corruption, driving once-peaceful furbolg tribes into murderous madness. Among the fiercest of these hostile chieftains was Ran Bloodtooth. Recovering his skull provides the night elf Sentinels with definite proof that the brute has fallen, breaking his hold over the local furbolgs and offering a small measure of respite to the beleaguered town of Astranaar.

sections.title: Honoring the Fallen
sections.body: When presented to Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar, the skull marks the conclusion of an investigation sparked by the fallen scout Teronis. Alongside Dartol's Rod—an ancient artifact cleansed of corruption—Ran Bloodtooth's skull is kept on display as a testament to the courage of those who fought to preserve the sacred forest.

faq.answer: Ran Bloodtooth was a chieftain of the corrupted furbolgs in Ashenvale, regarded by the night elf Sentinels as one of the fiercest regional threats.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels want his skull?
aliases: why do i need the skull
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar requires physical proof of Ran Bloodtooth's defeat. The skull is placed alongside Dartol's Rod as a symbol of victory and remembrance for those lost defending Ashenvale.

Teronis was a night elf Sentinel who died while attempting to cleanse an enchanted rod and uncover the source of the furbolg madness plaguing Ashenvale. His efforts were taken up by Raene Wolfrunner and visiting adventurers.

angles.text: For the night elves, taking the skull is a somber victory. While it avenges Teronis, it is also a reminder of how deeply demonic corruption has ravaged their former furbolg allies.
Delivering this grim trophy proves the mettle of Alliance champions in defending the fragile borders of Ashenvale alongside the Sentinels.
